Thursday, December 11, 2025 – 10:00 AM ET
1300 Longworth
Washington, DC
Full Committee on Agriculture

RE: “CFTC Reauthorization: Stakeholder Perspectives”

WITNESS LIST:
The Honorable Dawn D. Stump, Former Commissioner, Commodity Futures Trading Commission, Washington, DC.
Mr. Edward Prosser, Senior Vice President, Special Projects, the Scoular Company and Member of the Board, Commodity Markets Council, Omaha, NE; on Behalf of the Commodity Markets Council.
Ms. Alicia Crighton, Managing Director, Global Co-head of Futures, and Head of OTC and Prime Clearing at Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC and Chair, Futures Industry Association, New York, NY; on Behalf of the Futures Industry Association.
Mr. Rob Schwartz, Partner, Morgan, Lewis & Bockius and Former General Counsel, Commodity Futures Trading Commission, Washington, DC.
Mr. Benjamin Schiffrin, Director of Securities Policy, Better Markets, Washington, DC.
